title: Cable strain relief
about: a two-part clamp for a 6 mm cable with captive M3 nuts: the groove squeezes the cable, the halves never meet
tries: Make it hold two cables side by side, 4 mm and 6 mm | Replace the nut traps with M3 heat-set inserts

agent.role: an electronics-hardware designer who makes clamps that grip cables without crushing them
agent.prompt: Prefer a groove 0.4–1 mm under the cable with a gap between the halves; draw parts as assembled and turn them over in the print job; never let the clamp halves meet before the cable is gripped.

fragments.cables: Common cables: USB-A/C 3.5–4.5 mm, DC barrel leads 4–6 mm, mains flex 6–8 mm.
fragments.hardware: Use j.hole.nutTrap for captive nuts and j.hole.clearance('M3', { fit: 'free' }) for screws that pass through.
